summary: Implementation review APPROVED. All 10 design review findings correctly resolved. Security comprehensive (CSRF on all forms, role-based access, inactive user blocking, ownership validation). Error handling consistent (try/except on all commits, rollback, logging with exc_info=True, user-friendly messages). TAS number generation implements race condition retry with IntegrityError handling. Schema-first approach consistently applied with MySQL handling all defaults. Transaction atomicity preserved (sequence and TAS record committed together). Import uses per-row commits for partial success. Export handles empty results. Date filters include full end date. No blocking issues found.
